title: provider.py search NAME TERMS queries a provider's own search API before a session uses WebSearch
goal: provider.py search NAME TERMS [--max N] queries the search_api of a provider row (Learn's api/search, the arXiv export API's search_query, GitHub's repository and code search, PyPI's JSON for a project name) and prints title, url and date per hit, cached for 7 days like docs_search; providers.csv gains the arXiv, GitHub and PyPI search_api values; kb-research step 3 tries it for a vendor or project with a row before WebSearch; the suite tests each provider's request and parsing with stubbed responses.
notes: Premise: _tools/providers.csv has a search_api only on its learn row (2026-10-11); this session's research found arXiv papers through export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query=ti:... with no WebSearch call. Depends on ST-7zkw23ca for the provider rows and cache it adds.
